facts.fact: The verdict's steps are named by VERDICT_STEP_LABELS; stepLabels joins the names of the steps not done with listOf, and verdictStopped answers that list.

The list is shown to the GMs only: in the trial console's warning DRPG.Vote.verdictStopped ("The verdict stopped at: {steps}.") and in the GMs' summary whisper after a verdict (runVerdict, whisperToGms). In Polish it stands after a colon, in the nominative.
On a wrong verdict with a Blackened, the step asks this GM to type the Blackened's new rule (askBlackenedRule) and adds the line newRule or newRuleWritten to the GMs' summary.
The window and the rule it writes are called "The Blackened's new rule" (DRPG.Vote.blackenedRuleTitle); the rule is announced to the table with no name on it.

facts.fact: When a Present card a player's browser posted reaches the primary GM, it is not raised on anyone's screen (no showPopup for a player's card) and is marked refused.
For a Present card (kind "present") the primary whispers this text to the owner of the character the card speaks as (whisperToOwner: that player and the GMs).
The way to present is the Present button (a gavel icon, tooltip DRPG.Trial.presentTooltip "Present" / "Przedstaw") on a Truth Bullet's row of the character sheet, which opens the Present window.
The card of a Present made through the window is posted by the primary GM, with a copy for every other participant (requestPresent, "trial.present").

en.before: Evidence is presented with Present on your sheet, and the GM's browser posts its card. That card was not posted that way, so nobody was shown it.
en.after: Present evidence with the Present button, the gavel on a Truth Bullet's row of your character sheet. That card did not come from the button, so it stays off the table.

pl.after: Dowody przedstawiasz przyciskiem Przedstaw z ikoną młotka w wierszu Truth Bulletu na arkuszu postaci. Ta karta nie powstała w ten sposób, więc nie trafia na stół.

facts.fact: The lead takes this step while a round mode (Testimony or Panic Round) holds the floor.
A round's speakers speak one at a time, in an order frozen at its start (roundOrder: the trial's participants), each first speaker with a connected owner.
The bar's Skip ends the running turn and the round moves to the next speaker (a round's turn is skipped the same way).
The bar's End this mode ends the round (glossary gm-bar-buttons: "End this mode" / "Zakończ ten tryb"; "Skip" / "Pomiń").

en.after: A round holds the floor, and its speakers take turns. Skip moves to the next speaker, and End this mode ends the round.
